title: Navan, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Navan, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 13, 2026 (signed April 17, 2026) announcing the departure of Anne Giviskos as Senior Vice President, Strategic Finance and Chief Accounting Officer, effective April 17, 2026. Aurélien Nolf, the Company's CFO, will assume the principal accounting officer role. The filing details Ms. Giviskos's entitlement to severance benefits under her Change in Control and Severance Agreement.
key_points: Anne Giviskos departed as Senior Vice President, Strategic Finance and Chief Accounting Officer, effective April 17, 2026
Aurélien Nolf (CFO) assumed the principal accounting officer role as of April 17, 2026
Ms. Giviskos is entitled to payments and benefits under a 'Qualifying Non-CIC Termination' per her severance agreement
The severance agreement form was filed as Exhibit 10.8 to the Company's Form S-1 on October 10, 2025
The filing was signed by Ariel Cohen, Chief Executive Officer, on April 17, 2026
